tracks.title: 算鳥 Sǹg Tsiáu
tracks.subject: a volunteer on the January black-faced spoonbill census at a Tainan fish-pond roost at half past five, counting sleeping birds through a scope in the north wind while a retired teacher clicks the tally counter, losing the count at 240 when a kite circles and the whole flock lifts, and starting again to find twenty more than last year
